name: intervals
objective: Merge integer time intervals and compute gaps and peak concurrency
task: Implement merge_intervals(intervals) where intervals is a list of integer pairs 0<=start<end (bool is not an integer here). Reject all other values with ValueError. Return sorted merged tuples, merging overlaps and touching intervals; do not mutate input. Implement gaps(intervals,start,end): require integer non-bool 0<=start<end and every interval inside that window; return sorted uncovered tuples. Implement peak_load(intervals): maximum concurrent half-open intervals, touching endpoints do not overlap; empty ->0. CLI python module.py reads JSON {"intervals":[...],"start":int,"end":int} stdin and outputs JSON with merged,gaps,peak keys. Invalid -> exit2 concise stderr. Document half-open/touching semantics and examples. Python stdlib only. Modify module.py and README.md only. Never edit tests/build/.autopilot. Run python test_module.py and python build.py.
